instruction: Retail pavilion IFC model. Create a single-storey retail pavilion from scratch in Revit and export it to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc using the IFC4 schema. The pavilion should have two glazed street-facing facades and a rear back-of-house zone. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, four IfcSpace objects, five IfcWall elements, one IfcSlab, and one IfcRoof. Name the spaces so they include Retail, Storage, Prep, and Toilet. Include at least three IfcDoor elements, six IfcWindow elements, and two IfcCurtainWall elements. Do not include IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcStair, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. Size the shaped model to span 16.5-19.5 m in X, 10.5-13.5 m in Y, and 3.3-4.5 m in Z. Place one curtain wall within 1.0 m of the minimum-Y edge of the shaped model and another within 1.0 m of the maximum-X edge. Locate the Storage, Prep, and Toilet space centroids at Y coordinates of at least 8.0 m so they read as rear-of-house spaces. Other finishes and exact storefront detailing may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique.
